notes.title: Version 2.1.12
notes.notes:
[h1] Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Leaderboard no longer overflows UI.
[*]Leaderboard paging now works.
[*]Global leaderboard now works.
[*]Achievements now track progress correctly.
[*]Possible fix for wireless controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date & launch trailer!
notes.notes:
Before I say anything else, let me just say this...

FRIDAY, MAY 11TH

Wow - that feels GOOD!

But wait... what good is a release date without a kick-ass launch trailer to go with it? Don't worry, we didn't forget. Check out the store page for the brand new launch trailer!
